name: CAMO CLOAK
text: When an enemy shoots a friendly Scout Squad operative other than the Sniper and it can retain any cover saves, it retains one more (never as a crit; Saturate still works).

name: TARGETING OCULARS
text: Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly Scout Squad operative performs a Shoot and you are selecting its target: until the end of that action its ranged weapons have Lethal 5+ and Saturate.

name: COMBAT BLADE
text: Every friendly Scout Squad operative carries a combat blade (Atk 3, Hit 3+, Dmg 4/5) for the battle; one that already has the better datacard blade keeps its own.

name: TACTICAL VOX-LINK
text: Once per turning point, while a friendly Sergeant is in the killzone, Astartes Training or Emboldened Aspirant costs 0 CP.
